identity.question: Will OpenRouter process less than 575T tokens from Sep 28 to Oct 25?

operative_rule: Resolution sums four exact weekly totals displayed on the Top Models chart, Monday labels Sep 28, Oct 5, Oct 12, and Oct 19, 2026. Weeks run Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:59 UTC; each completed week continues to update until the following week is first displayed. Lock on first display of Oct 26; fallback is Oct 30 23:59 ET. Resolution uses chart display totals including rounding; exact-boundary tie goes to higher bracket.

observations.rows: Four requested Monday labels are present with ten series each, including Others. Sep 28, Oct 5, and Oct 12 weeks had ended by the 18:17 UTC call; Oct 19–25 was partial at capture. Row sums are raw API values in the linked array file, not verified text-rendered UI totals.
observations.display_limit: The API response contains exact series values and cachedAt but does not establish the rendered UI rounding; use the frozen chart-display rule. Do not equate raw API sum to exact displayed settlement value without a matching UI capture.
